## Appearance

Dick Moore is a big man who was once considered a handsome fellow, though he has badly gone to fat. He features a broad, round, red face with a high color, vacant eyes, and hair that is a lighter shade than George's. In a distinct family trait, his eyes are mismatched, with one being blue and the other hazel.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick is a mentally deficient man who was formerly a drunkard. He is generally vacant, harmless, and good-natured, making him easily controlled. However, he can occasionally experience fractious spells, at times coming across as a big and annoying baby.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P23](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0023), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P31](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044)_

## History

Dick Moore was a man living in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) in a tragic situation, cared for by his wife [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) while lacking his memory and sanity. After Captain Jim helped lead Dick home one fog-filled evening, Dr. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) eventually came to believe that an operation on his skull might restore his faculties. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), Captain Jim, and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) decided to pursue the procedure in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal), borrowing money to pay for it. The operation was successful, but it restored the man's memory only to reveal that he was actually Dick's cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that the real Dick Moore had died years prior in Cuba.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P2](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P3](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P6](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P7](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P9](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0009), +336 more_

## Relationships

### [George](../character/george.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george.md)

[George](../character/george.md) is Dick Moore's double cousin. Due to a striking physical resemblance between the two men, [George](../character/george.md) was mistakenly believed to be Dick for years following a period of lost memory. The mix-up was finally resolved when [George](../character/george.md) underwent an operation that restored his memory, revealing that the real Dick had died years earlier.

- Relative of — double cousins (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P11](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0011)</sub>

### [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--george-moore.md)

[George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) is Dick's cousin whose identity was mistaken for Dick's over a period of many years. After undergoing a medical operation in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal), [George](../character/george.md) regained his memory, confirming the mix-up and revealing that Dick had actually died years prior. Following his recovery, [George](../character/george.md) was taken back to his home in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) by his sister.

- Relative of — cousin (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), +1 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--leslie-moore.md)

[Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) is Dick's wife, though their marriage was burdened by deep tragedy and emotional distance. For years, she carried the tragic burden of caring for the man she believed to be her husband, which caused her severe grief and inner conflict. The relationship ultimately reached a turning point when it was discovered that the man she was caring for was actually Dick's cousin, and that Dick himself had died years ago.

- Spouse of — married (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P3](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0003), +9 more</sub>

### [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick--uncle-jim.md)

[Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md), also known as Captain Jim, played a supportive role in managing Dick by finding him and leading him home to his family. Captain Jim was deeply familiar with the tragic situation surrounding Dick and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), often discussing their hardship with neighbors like [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to foster sympathy for their plight.

- Saved by (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY P46](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0046)</sub>
